Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

regcompR 0.1.0

  • First release.
  • family_capabilities() (formerly capabilities(), renamed so that attaching the package masks no base R function) labels family specific numerical methods "algorithm", separately from closed forms ("analytic") and the generic fallback ("numeric").
  • scoring_rule(re = "marginal") scores the predictive law of a new group, mixing over draws of its random effects. cv_regcomp(group = ) now scores held out groups this way by default (previously with the effects set to zero; re = "zero" restores that) and clusters the standard error by group.
  • The multivariate hypergeometric law takes the number of draws size.
  • Finite difference scores and Hessians respect joint parameter constraints.
  • Registry of 278 distribution families with densities, distribution functions, quantiles, random generation, moments and references.
  • Distributional regression by maximum likelihood with a Laplace approximation for random effects and smooths, through TMB (RTMB), and by Bayesian inference in Stan, JAGS and OpenBUGS.
  • Random effects in any parameter with nested, crossed, structured (AR(1), compound symmetry, unstructured, Ornstein Uhlenbeck, spatial kernels) and multiple membership terms.
  • Ordinal, nominal, bivariate binary and sample selection models.
  • Operators for inflation, hurdles, truncation, censoring, mixtures, compounding, convolution, splicing, cure models and copulas.
  • Generalized estimating equations, cluster robust covariances, exact Poisson regression, quantile regression for counts and person period expansion for discrete time hazards.
  • Residuals, scoring rules, cross validation, model comparison and plots.

Developed by Adam R Sophie.
